title: Egypt Crop Rotation Optimizer — curated public reference data
scope: Ten representative crops documented in the project field guide; public agronomy values are separated from Egypt-local evidence. Not a fully calibrated production dataset.
units_note: FAO-56 Kc values are dimensionless reference coefficients. Root depths are metres. Kc and root-depth values are not automatically Egypt-calibrated.
data_availability_note: User confirms weather and SoilGrids were downloaded for all configured governorates, but those Windows files were not available in this workspace to ingest. This file therefore provides the crop/catalog reference layer, not the user’s raw governorate JSON.
optimizer_warning: Do not use null/missing water_units, soil_health_points, income_points or stage thermal thresholds as zero. The current demo optimizer requires integer proxy coefficients; obtain expert-approved local scores or modify the model to derive water outcomes from ET0 × Kc and simulations. All candidates must be simulated and ranked using real project outputs.
